# SRVCABLE — Sarvottam Cables Ltd
As of: 2026-09-23

## Snapshot
Sarvottam Cables Ltd (NSE: SRVCABLE) makes power cables, wires and conductors; Q1 FY27 ended on 30 June 2026. [S-e4dc6442b586]
Q1 consolidated revenue rose 18.0% to ₹1,248 crore per the issuer, conflicting with Business Daily's report of ₹1,428 crore and 35% growth. [S-e4dc6442b586] [S-a41e9e2f21c8]
Profit after tax rose 5.9% to ₹82 crore, but EBITDA (an operating profitability measure) fell as a share of revenue from 12.9% to 11.2%. [S-e4dc6442b586]

## Bull case

The order book reached ₹3,900 crore at 30 June 2026, versus ₹3,150 crore a year earlier; exports contributed 21% of quarterly revenue, versus 16%. [S-e4dc6442b586]

Management guides for 15–17% FY27 revenue growth and expects Bharuch production in Q3 FY27, with about 30% additional cable capacity. [S-3a36f4ac4109] [S-e4dc6442b586]

Management says data-centre cables contribute about 9% of domestic revenue and thinks that share can double in two years. [S-3a36f4ac4109]

Pledges were 4.1% of promoter holdings at 30 June 2026, versus 11.5% a year earlier; the 35% news report was published in March 2024. [S-32ec5735c356] [S-156eefbe9bcf]

## Bear case

Management attributes margin pressure mainly to copper; approximately two-thirds of contracts permit price changes, with resets delayed by one to two quarters. [S-3a36f4ac4109]

The CFO reports receivable days rising from 78 to 96 over the last year, chiefly because two state utilities pay slowly, with no defaults observed. [S-3a36f4ac4109]

The CFO reports ₹620 crore of Bharuch investment, about 70% spent, funded mainly by cash generated internally and some loans; net debt is 0.35 times equity. [S-3a36f4ac4109]

The company received a ₹46.3 crore GST demand, including interest and penalty, relating to FY2020-21 and FY2021-22 input tax credits. [S-4a0ebad90ad1]

It intends to appeal and expects no material financial or operational impact, according to management. [S-4a0ebad90ad1]

## Open questions

- Will copper-price adjustments restore margins, and will collections support the remaining Bharuch spending? [S-3a36f4ac4109]
- What is the GST appeal timetable and eventual cash cost, if any? [S-4a0ebad90ad1]
- What are the current share price, valuation multiples and cash-flow forecasts?

# Promoter pledge at Sarvottam Cables rises to 35%, raising governance concerns

The promoters of Sarvottam Cables Ltd have increased the share of their holding that is pledged with lenders to 35%, up from 22% six months ago, according to exchange data.
